notes:
ACCESS: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked first). Tier 1 (direct HTTP via curl) was blocked: homepage returned 200 but every guessed/real category URL (e.g. christmas.html, patio-furniture.html, home-decor.html) returned 403 from Akamai, and the site's product/category APIs (gdx-api.costco.com, search.costco.com) require a client-generated auth token (401 Missing credentials) that curl cannot replicate. Tier 2 (Playwright/Chromium headless) was blocked at the connection level: net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET on every attempt, even with --disable-http2, indicating bot-fingerprint rejection. Moved to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, a real logged-out consumer browser session) which loaded the site normally with no CAPTCHA/block encountered; all data below was gathered there. Pages are heavy (Adobe/Dynatrace telemetry) so product grids sometimes took 5-10s to hydrate from a 'Loading' skeleton to real content; each page was re-polled until real content (breadcrumb + 'Showing X of Y') appeared before recording qty.

DISCOVERY: Used the site's own mega-menu/search ('christmas decor' query) to find the real Category facet 'Holiday & Seasonal' (66 hits), which resolved to the genuine department landing page https://www.costco.com/seasonal.html. That page's own taxonomy groups two seasonal branches relevant to decor: 'Halloween & Back-to-School Essentials' and 'Christmas & Holiday Essentials' (a third group, 'Summer Outdoor & Party Gear', is year-round/non-holiday and was excluded). Each tile was opened directly; breadcrumbs confirm genuine site taxonomy (e.g. Holiday & Seasonal > Christmas & Holiday > Christmas Decorations > Christmas Ornaments). 'Christmas Decorations' (home-seasonal.html) is itself a real PLP that aggregates 55 products which are the union of its 6 child sub-categories (3+6+10+10+4+23=56, matching within a 1-item rounding/overlap) -- per the parent/child rule this is recorded as a grouping row (qty null, link null) and NOT double-counted against its 6 children. 'Christmas Lights' (christmas-lights.html) is NOT nested under Holiday & Seasonal in the breadcrumb (it lives under Home Improvement > Lighting & Ceiling Light Fixtures > Outdoor Lighting) but is an explicitly Christmas-named, genuine PLP, so it is included per the rule that category location doesn't matter, only genuine holiday association + real PLP.

Spot-checks: 3 of the 6 'Christmas Decorations' children were independently re-verified by direct page visit and matched the parent facet count exactly (Outdoor Christmas Decorations 23/23, Christmas Ornaments 6/6, Christmas Table Top Decorations 10/10); the remaining 3 (Angels & Nativity Sets 3, Christmas Wreaths/Garlands/Centerpieces 10, Nutcrackers/Holiday Statues/Figurines 4) were taken from that same parent page's live category facet (exact structured counts, not estimates).

EXCLUDED as out-of-scope per task instructions (food/apparel/non-decor), all genuinely present on-site but not recorded as rows: Halloween Candy (halloween-candy.html, food), Halloween Costumes (costume-dress-up.html, apparel), Back to School Supplies/Uniforms (not seasonal/holiday). Holiday Gift Baskets (holiday-gift-baskets.html, 75 results) is a food/gourmet-gift category under Floral & Gift Baskets > Gift Baskets, not home/decor -- excluded as food gifting, flagged here for reviewer awareness in case a broader reading is wanted. Holiday Cards, Wrapping Paper & Ribbons (holiday-cards-wrapping-paper.html) resolved to a generic 0-result 'no match' search fallback page (not a live category), so excluded as not currently a valid PLP.

OTHER HOLIDAYS CHECKED AND CONFIRMED ABSENT (no dedicated category -- zero-result-style searches were not relied on alone; each was checked via the site's own Category facet breakdown on real search-results pages, not just raw hit count): Easter ('easter decorations' -> 2 results, both under Patio Lawn & Garden with no Holiday & Seasonal facet -- generic garden decor, not a genuine Easter category); Valentine's Day ('valentines day decor' -> 21 results, 17 under Floral & Gift Baskets i.e. flowers/gift baskets, only 1 under Holiday & Seasonal -- no dedicated Valentine's category); Thanksgiving ('thanksgiving decor' -> 3 results, generic fall/pumpkin items, one explicitly a 'Halloween Decorative Pillow' -- no dedicated Thanksgiving category); New Year ('new year decorations' -> 3 unrelated results, an ornament advent calendar and a Nightmare Before Christmas wreath -- no dedicated New Year category); Diwali ('diwali' -> 11 results scattered across Clothing, Floral & Gift Baskets, Grocery, Jewelry & Watches -- no Holiday & Seasonal hits at all, no dedicated category). No genuine PLP exists for any of these on Costco US as of this check; all are correctly recorded as absent, not as rows.

QTY METHOD: displayed PLP total ('Showing X of Y') was used wherever the page was directly visited; the same-session live category facet count was used for the 3 unverified 'Christmas Decorations' children (structured-data tier, exact not estimated). No qty was inferred, summed, or copied from a parent/site-wide number.
